summary.text: Democrat Beau Bayh won the election for Indiana Secretary of State on November 3, 2026, defeating Max Engling, according to unofficial results, and is set to take office when the new term begins.
An Indianapolis attorney making his first run for office, he is a Marine Corps veteran and the son of former Gov. and Sen. Evan Bayh.

paragraphs.text: Bayh earned both his bachelor's degree in government and his law degree from Harvard University.
He served as a captain in the U.S. Marine Corps.
He is the grandson of former Sen. Birch Bayh.
Bayh worked as a judicial law clerk for Judge David F. Hamilton of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit until August 2025, and later as an attorney in Indianapolis.
He had not previously run for office.
He won his party's nomination at the Indiana Democratic convention on June 6, 2026.
He said he was running "to fix a corrupt office, and to take on a broken political system that doesn't serve us."

He won the November 3, 2026 general election for Secretary of State of Indiana with 51.8% of the vote to Max Engling's 42.6% and Greg Ballard's 3.6% and 1 other candidate, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
